nodes.name: Decomposition Group
nodes.statement: The decomposition group of $L/K$ is the subgroup \[\{\sigma\in\Gal(L/K)\mid \sigma(\mathcal{O}_L) \subset \mathcal{O}_L\}\] of $\Gal(L/K)$
nodes.statement_short: Galois automorphisms of $L/K$ preserving the valuation ring $\mathcal{O}_L$.
nodes.label: decompositionGroup

nodes.name: Lower Index
nodes.statement_short: Lower index of a Galois automorphism: $\infty$ for the identity; the case $\sigma\ne1$ is left blank in the source.
nodes.label: lowerIndex

nodes.name: lowerIndex_eq_top_iff_eq_refl
nodes.statement: If $\sigma\in\Gal(L/K)$ lies in the decomposition group of $L/K$, then \[i_{L/K}(\sigma) = \infty\iff s = 1.\]
assumptions: $\sigma\in\Gal(L/K)$ lies in the decomposition group of $L/K$
nodes.statement_short: For $\sigma$ in the decomposition group, the lower index is infinite exactly when $\sigma$ is the identity.
nodes.label: lowerIndex_eq_top_iff_eq_refl

nodes.name: Vanishing of lower ramification groups
nodes.statement: The lower ramification groups $\Gal(L/K)_{u}$ vanish for $u\in\Z$ large enough.
conclusions: The lower ramification groups $\Gal(L/K)_{u}$ vanish for $u\in\Z$ large enough.
nodes.label: exist_lowerRamificationGroup_eq_bot
